scope: Create a reviewable normal two-parent merge of exact canonical main into the paused exact ECO head, prove the candidate removes aggregate ECO PC0 RED without a runtime tree delta, open a draft PR targeting ECO, and stop before that PR is merged.
required_outputs: Pre-merge RED and synthetic post-merge NON_RED reports
stop_conditions: origin/main, ECO source, passport blob, or source dry-merge tree moves at any point through merge creation, synthetic PC0, evidence, exact review, draft PR, or human merge
Merge conflict or non-control tree delta appears
Synthetic standard PC0 remains RED or directional PC0 becomes RED
Any runtime, passport, ecology, registry, or architecture edit is required
CONTROL_DOCS_ONLY_MERGE approval has not been granted
risk_reasons: Dependency integration changes ECO branch ancestry and PC0 critical-drift evaluation.
A false synthetic non-RED verdict could incorrectly unblock H0.0.
The candidate has no runtime tree delta and changes no ownership, identity, or foundation contract, so CRITICAL triggers are absent.

design_brief.problem_statement: ECO was paused at 67e23224, but its merge-base with main remained 790fd79f. Its copied registry content could not remove the resulting critical dependency-drift RED.
design_brief.current_behavior: R2 produced a reviewed draft candidate and then correctly stopped at the human merge gate. Before approval, the ECO target advanced from 67e23224 to 2a4c3103, invalidating the exact-source freshness pin.
design_brief.desired_behavior: R2 remains immutable historical evidence and cannot authorize promotion after source movement; a fresh R3 must repin the current ECO source and repeat the complete integration verification lifecycle.
alternatives_considered: Rewrite R2 evidence to the new target
Invalidate R2 and create fresh R3
design_brief.selected_design: Fail closed: preserve all R2 evidence and Draft PR #68, append an EPOCH_INVALIDATED event, mark the epoch/work order invalidated, and require a fresh R3 from the exact current ECO target.
design_brief.why_selected: This follows the recorded freshness rule and prevents stale PASS evidence from authorizing a different target SHA.
non_goals: No ECO runtime or research edit
validation_plan: Keep Draft PR #68 open/unmerged as historical evidence.
Require project epoch INVALIDATED and work order EPOCH_INVALIDATED.
Start R3 only from exact current ECO target and repeat all source pins, merge topology, synthetic PC0, review and verifier checks.

notes: R1 remains terminal EPOCH_INVALIDATED. R2 is now terminal EPOCH_INVALIDATED because ECO advanced from 67e23224ae153a9fc43ca5feea21c50165a99f1d to 2a4c3103234717f813cd6fe8f60de0d50f3012ba before human merge. All R2 evidence and Draft PR #68 remain historical and must not authorize promotion.
